hold_text: Lane PHONE-BALANCE-READ dispatch: Tier-2 (new write to the prop status store), 'the manager merges'.
why: Phone reads the terminal account panel (read-only) and posts kind=account_status through /phone/report; the server validates it (finite non-negative, absent stays NULL, refused if neither value) and stores it as MEASURED. No sizing, order-path or config change.
